mapper.sql: CASE WHEN CAST(ss.status AS BINARY) IN ('EMPLOYED', 'SEEKING', 'NEED_HELP') THEN ss.status ELSE 'CHECK_REQUIRED' END
CASE WHEN CAST(ss.status AS BINARY) = 'SEEKING' THEN CASE WHEN CAST(ss.sub_status AS BINARY) IN ('APPLYING', 'OTHER') THEN ss.sub_status ELSE 'WAITING' END ELSE NULL END
FROM student s LEFT JOIN student_status ss ON ss.student_id = s.id

s.id AS student_id, s.name, CONCAT(c.name, ' ', c.cohort) AS course_label, s.completed_on, AS status, AS sub_status, s.last_response_at, (EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM recommendation_item ri_note JOIN recommendation r_note ON r_note.id = ri_note.recommendation_id WHERE r_note.student_id = s.id AND REGEXP_LIKE(ri_note.pass_note, '[^[:space:]]') ) OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM contact_log WHERE student_id = s.id )) AS has_note
mapper.select:
SELECT , s.email, s.desired_job, s.preferred_region, ss.reason, cp.profile AS competency_profile
JOIN course c ON c.id = s.course_id LEFT JOIN competency_profile cp ON cp.student_id = s.id WHERE s.id = #{studentId}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_education WHERE student_id = #{studentId}) AS education, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_certificate WHERE student_id = #{studentId}) AS certificates, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_project WHERE student_id = #{studentId}) AS projects, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM student_cover_letter WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ) AS has_cover_letter
SELECT id AS recommendation_id, created_at FROM recommendation WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT r.id AS recommendation_id, ri.id AS item_id, j.company_name, j.title, ri.response, ri.pass_reason, ri.pass_note, ri.responded_at, a.id AS application_id, a.status AS application_status FROM recommendation r JOIN recommendation_item ri ON ri.recommendation_id = r.id JOIN job_posting j ON j.id = ri.job_posting_id LEFT JOIN application a ON a.recommendation_item_id = ri.id AND a.student_id = r.student_id WHERE r.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY ri.rank_no ASC, ri.id ASC
SELECT id AS contact_log_id, student_id, contact_type, note, created_at FROM contact_log WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contact_log (student_id, contact_type, note, created_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{contactType}, #{note,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{createdAt})
